### Introduction

FATES (Functionally Assembled Terrestrial Ecosystem Simulator) is a dynamic vegetation model integrated into CLM (Community Land Model). The PEcAn package `PEcAn.FATES` provides integration with the PEcAn workflow system.

### Installation

```r
# Install from r-universe
options(repos = c(
  pecanproject = 'https://pecanproject.r-universe.dev',
  CRAN = 'https://cloud.r-project.org'))
install.packages('PEcAn.FATES')
```
